meta.title: LAN automatic sign-in
meta.description: Adds a same-port /lan entry that lets a LAN device sign in to the existing DSH WebUI through the native browser session. Any device that can reach the entry gets operator access; the listener, port, authentication and APIs are unchanged.

ui.settings.title: LAN automatic sign-in
ui.settings.description: Open this entry from another device instead of copying a temporary login URL. The Host keeps its existing bind address and port, and DSH's native token exchange and HttpOnly cookie still complete the sign-in. Any device that can reach the entry gets the same operator access.
ui.notice.permissions: Anyone who can reach this entry can operate this DSH as the native browser operator. Share it only on a trusted LAN and keep the port behind your usual network controls. There is no per-device approval or revocation.
ui.notice.cookies: Disabling or removing this plugin withdraws the /lan route and this settings card. Native browser cookies already issued stay valid until they expire or the native sign-in state is cleared; this plugin offers no per-device revocation.
ui.unavailable.title: Entry unavailable
ui.unavailable.bootstrap: This page did not receive the LAN entry record from the Host. The plugin may still be starting, or it may be disabled.
ui.unavailable.hint: Enable the plugin, then reload this page. Do not type a login URL by hand.
ui.entry.proxy: The server listener is bound to loopback; other devices reach it through the advertised entry (usually a proxy or forward). Confirm that entry still points at this DSH service.
ui.warn.http: The advertised entry uses plain HTTP, so traffic may be readable on the LAN. Use it only on a trusted network, or switch to an HTTPS entry.
ui.warn.loopback: The advertised entry uses a loopback address, so other LAN devices cannot reach it.
ui.warn.loopback.hint: To allow LAN access, advertise a reachable LAN address or use an existing trusted proxy. This plugin never changes the listener address, port, or proxy.
ui.qr.title: QR code (generated locally)
ui.qr.alt: QR code for the LAN entry link
ui.qr.caption: Scan this from a device on the same network. The QR code contains only the entry link, never a token.
ui.qr.caption.loopback: The QR code still encodes the entry link, but a loopback-bound listener is not reachable from another device.
ui.qr.failed: The QR code could not be generated. Copy the link instead.
ui.lan.title: LAN candidates (unverified)
ui.lan.caption: These private IPv4 addresses come from the Host's network interfaces. They are suggestions, not proof that another device can reach them. Fix this machine's LAN IP in your router before sharing.
ui.lan.empty: No private IPv4 interface was reported for this machine.
ui.lan.noLink: no link can be formed from this address
ui.copy.unavailable: This page (usually plain HTTP) has no Clipboard API. The link is selected; copy it manually.
ui.copy.manual: The browser blocked the clipboard. The link is selected; copy it manually.
ui.copy.failed: The clipboard is unavailable. Select and copy the link manually.
